Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://tenkasi.dcourts.gov.in/. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Tenkasi Para Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DLSA Tenkasi Para Legal Volunteer posts is 31st August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required is passing the 10th Standard. Additionally, candidates should possess reading comprehension skills, and preference will be given to those with computer typing skills in English and Tamil.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an honorarium of Rs. 750 per day for the Para Legal Volunteer post. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the DLSA Tenkasi Para Legal Volunteer job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive, as per the available information.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves two stages: Application Screening and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and then called for verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Legal Services Authority Tenkasi, which is https://tenkasi.dcourts.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Para Legal Volunteer post is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions of the authority.

faq.question: Q9. Does DLSA Tenkasi provide any age relaxation?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q10. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification date for this recruitment was 03 August 2026, and the last date to apply is 31 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the authority before the closing date.
